method.execution: Seven fresh child-process executions from the repository root using the Release target.
method.instrumentation: Reset after warm-up; diagnostic getters do not increment the FFI counter. State and cache peaks are relative to the warmed baseline.
coverage: repeated text measurements and warmed cache reuse

decision.counter_limits: Freeze exact observed steady-state structural counts. Any extra allocation, string, recomputation, upload, cache entry, or scene operation is a regression requiring review rather than a relaxed threshold.
decision.timing_limits: The 100 us mean and 2000 us single-frame ceilings remain far above the seven-sample Release observations while bounding meaningful CPU regressions and tolerating ordinary scheduler noise in Debug and CI runs.
decision.updates: Budgets must be recalibrated from known-good integrated infrastructure with recorded environment and method. A failing change may not weaken a limit solely to pass.
